blocks.source: Canto XII
blocks.translation: Canto XII

blocks.source: Era lo loco ov’ a scender la riva
blocks.translation: The place where to descend the bank we came

blocks.source: venimmo, alpestro e, per quel che v’er’ anco,
blocks.translation: Was alpine, and from what was there, moreover,

blocks.source: tal, ch’ogne vista ne sarebbe schiva.
blocks.translation: Of such a kind that every eye would shun it.

blocks.source: Qual è quella ruina che nel fianco
blocks.translation: Such as that ruin is which in the flank

blocks.source: di qua da Trento l’Adice percosse,
blocks.translation: Smote, on this side of Trent, the Adige,

blocks.source: o per tremoto o per sostegno manco,
blocks.translation: Either by earthquake or by failing stay,

blocks.source: che da cima del monte, onde si mosse,
blocks.translation: For from the mountain’s top, from which it moved,

blocks.source: al piano è sì la roccia discoscesa,
blocks.translation: Unto the plain the cliff is shattered so,

blocks.source: ch’alcuna via darebbe a chi sù fosse:
blocks.translation: Some path ’twould give to him who was above;

blocks.source: cotal di quel burrato era la scesa;
blocks.translation: Even such was the descent of that ravine,

blocks.source: e ’n su la punta de la rotta lacca
blocks.translation: And on the border of the broken chasm

blocks.source: l’infamïa di Creti era distesa
blocks.translation: The infamy of Crete was stretched along,

blocks.source: che fu concetta ne la falsa vacca;
blocks.translation: Who was conceived in the fictitious cow;

blocks.source: e quando vide noi, sé stesso morse,
blocks.translation: And when he us beheld, he bit himself,

blocks.source: sì come quei cui l’ira dentro fiacca.
blocks.translation: Even as one whom anger racks within.

blocks.source: Lo savio mio inver’ lui gridò: «Forse
blocks.translation: My Sage towards him shouted: “Peradventure

blocks.source: tu credi che qui sia ’l duca d’Atene,
blocks.translation: Thou think’st that here may be the Duke of Athens,

blocks.source: che sù nel mondo la morte ti porse?
blocks.translation: Who in the world above brought death to thee?

blocks.source: Pàrtiti, bestia, ché questi non vene
blocks.translation: Get thee gone, beast, for this one cometh not

blocks.source: ammaestrato da la tua sorella,
blocks.translation: Instructed by thy sister, but he comes

blocks.source: ma vassi per veder le vostre pene».
blocks.translation: In order to behold your punishments.”

blocks.source: Qual è quel toro che si slaccia in quella
blocks.translation: As is that bull who breaks loose at the moment

blocks.source: c’ha ricevuto già ’l colpo mortale,
blocks.translation: In which he has received the mortal blow,

blocks.source: che gir non sa, ma qua e là saltella,
blocks.translation: Who cannot walk, but staggers here and there,

blocks.source: vid’ io lo Minotauro far cotale;
blocks.translation: The Minotaur beheld I do the like;

blocks.source: e quello accorto gridò: «Corri al varco;
blocks.translation: And he, the wary, cried: “Run to the passage;

blocks.source: mentre ch’e’ ’nfuria, è buon che tu ti cale».
blocks.translation: While he wroth, ’tis well thou shouldst descend.”

blocks.source: Così prendemmo via giù per lo scarco
blocks.translation: Thus down we took our way o’er that discharge

blocks.source: di quelle pietre, che spesso moviensi
blocks.translation: Of stones, which oftentimes did move themselves

blocks.source: sotto i miei piedi per lo novo carco.
blocks.translation: Beneath my feet, from the unwonted burden.

blocks.source: Io gia pensando; e quei disse: «Tu pensi
blocks.translation: Thoughtful I went; and he said: “Thou art thinking

blocks.source: forse a questa ruina, ch’è guardata
blocks.translation: Perhaps upon this ruin, which is guarded

blocks.source: da quell’ ira bestial ch’i’ ora spensi.
blocks.translation: By that brute anger which just now I quenched.

blocks.source: Or vo’ che sappi che l’altra fïata
blocks.translation: Now will I have thee know, the other time

blocks.source: ch’i’ discesi qua giù nel basso inferno,
blocks.translation: I here descended to the nether Hell,

blocks.source: questa roccia non era ancor cascata.
blocks.translation: This precipice had not yet fallen down.

blocks.source: Ma certo poco pria, se ben discerno,
blocks.translation: But truly, if I well discern, a little

blocks.source: che venisse colui che la gran preda
blocks.translation: Before His coming who the mighty spoil

blocks.source: levò a Dite del cerchio superno,
blocks.translation: Bore off from Dis, in the supernal circle,

blocks.source: da tutte parti l’alta valle feda
blocks.translation: Upon all sides the deep and loathsome valley

blocks.source: tremò sì, ch’i’ pensai che l’universo
blocks.translation: Trembled so, that I thought the Universe

blocks.source: sentisse amor, per lo qual è chi creda
blocks.translation: Was thrilled with love, by which there are who think

blocks.source: più volte il mondo in caòsso converso;
blocks.translation: The world ofttimes converted into chaos;

blocks.source: e in quel punto questa vecchia roccia,
blocks.translation: And at that moment this primeval crag

blocks.source: qui e altrove, tal fece riverso.
blocks.translation: Both here and elsewhere made such overthrow.

blocks.source: Ma ficca li occhi a valle, ché s’approccia
blocks.translation: But fix thine eyes below; for draweth near

blocks.source: la riviera del sangue in la qual bolle
blocks.translation: The river of blood, within which boiling is

blocks.source: qual che per vïolenza in altrui noccia».
blocks.translation: Whoe’er by violence doth injure others.”

blocks.source: Oh cieca cupidigia e ira folle,
blocks.translation: O blind cupidity, O wrath insane,

blocks.source: che sì ci sproni ne la vita corta,
blocks.translation: That spurs us onward so in our short life,

blocks.source: e ne l’etterna poi sì mal c’immolle!
blocks.translation: And in the eternal then so badly steeps us!

blocks.source: Io vidi un’ampia fossa in arco torta,
blocks.translation: I saw an ample moat bent like a bow,

blocks.source: come quella che tutto ’l piano abbraccia,
blocks.translation: As one which all the plain encompasses,

blocks.source: secondo ch’avea detto la mia scorta;
blocks.translation: Conformable to what my Guide had said.

blocks.source: e tra ’l piè de la ripa ed essa, in traccia
blocks.translation: And between this and the embankment’s foot

blocks.source: corrien centauri, armati di saette,
blocks.translation: Centaurs in file were running, armed with arrows,

blocks.source: come solien nel mondo andare a caccia.
blocks.translation: As in the world they used the chase to follow.

blocks.source: Veggendoci calar, ciascun ristette,
blocks.translation: Beholding us descend, each one stood still,

blocks.source: e de la schiera tre si dipartiro
blocks.translation: And from the squadron three detached themselves,

blocks.source: con archi e asticciuole prima elette;
blocks.translation: With bows and arrows in advance selected;

blocks.source: e l’un gridò da lungi: «A qual martiro
blocks.translation: And from afar one cried: “Unto what torment

blocks.source: venite voi che scendete la costa?
blocks.translation: Come ye, who down the hillside are descending?

blocks.source: Ditel costinci; se non, l’arco tiro».
blocks.translation: Tell us from there; if not, I draw the bow.”

blocks.source: Lo mio maestro disse: «La risposta
blocks.translation: My Master said: “Our answer will we make

blocks.source: farem noi a Chirón costà di presso:
blocks.translation: To Chiron, near you there; in evil hour,

blocks.source: mal fu la voglia tua sempre sì tosta».
blocks.translation: That will of thine was evermore so hasty.”

blocks.source: Poi mi tentò, e disse: «Quelli è Nesso,
blocks.translation: Then touched he me, and said: “This one is Nessus,

blocks.source: che morì per la bella Deianira,
blocks.translation: Who perished for the lovely Dejanira,

blocks.source: e fé di sé la vendetta elli stesso.
blocks.translation: And for himself, himself did vengeance take.

blocks.source: E quel di mezzo, ch’al petto si mira,
blocks.translation: And he in the midst, who at his breast is gazing,

blocks.source: è il gran Chirón, il qual nodrì Achille;
blocks.translation: Is the great Chiron, who brought up Achilles;

blocks.source: quell’ altro è Folo, che fu sì pien d’ira.
blocks.translation: That other Pholus is, who was so wrathful.

blocks.source: Dintorno al fosso vanno a mille a mille,
blocks.translation: Thousands and thousands go about the moat

blocks.source: saettando qual anima si svelle
blocks.translation: Shooting with shafts whatever soul emerges

blocks.source: del sangue più che sua colpa sortille».
blocks.translation: Out of the blood, more than his crime allots.”

blocks.source: Noi ci appressammo a quelle fiere isnelle:
blocks.translation: Near we approached unto those monsters fleet;

blocks.source: Chirón prese uno strale, e con la cocca
blocks.translation: Chiron an arrow took, and with the notch

blocks.source: fece la barba in dietro a le mascelle.
blocks.translation: Backward upon his jaws he put his beard.

blocks.source: Quando s’ebbe scoperta la gran bocca,
blocks.translation: After he had uncovered his great mouth,

blocks.source: disse a’ compagni: «Siete voi accorti
blocks.translation: He said to his companions: “Are you ware

blocks.source: che quel di retro move ciò ch’el tocca?
blocks.translation: That he behind moveth whate’er he touches?

blocks.source: Così non soglion far li piè d’i morti».
blocks.translation: Thus are not wont to do the feet of dead men.”

blocks.source: E ’l mio buon duca, che già li er’ al petto,
blocks.translation: And my good Guide, who now was at his breast,

blocks.source: dove le due nature son consorti,
blocks.translation: Where the two natures are together joined,

blocks.source: rispuose: «Ben è vivo, e sì soletto
blocks.translation: Replied: “Indeed he lives, and thus alone

blocks.source: mostrar li mi convien la valle buia;
blocks.translation: Me it behoves to show him the dark valley;

blocks.source: necessità ’l ci ’nduce, e non diletto.
blocks.translation: Necessity, and not delight, impels us.

blocks.source: Tal si partì da cantare alleluia
blocks.translation: Some one withdrew from singing Halleluja,

blocks.source: che mi commise quest’ officio novo:
blocks.translation: Who unto me committed this new office;

blocks.source: non è ladron, né io anima fuia.
blocks.translation: No thief is he, nor I a thievish spirit.

blocks.source: Ma per quella virtù per cu’ io movo
blocks.translation: But by that virtue through which I am moving

blocks.source: li passi miei per sì selvaggia strada,
blocks.translation: My steps along this savage thoroughfare,

blocks.source: danne un de’ tuoi, a cui noi siamo a provo,
blocks.translation: Give us some one of thine, to be with us,

blocks.source: e che ne mostri là dove si guada,
blocks.translation: And who may show us where to pass the ford,

blocks.source: e che porti costui in su la groppa,
blocks.translation: And who may carry this one on his back;

blocks.source: ché non è spirto che per l’aere vada».
blocks.translation: For ’tis no spirit that can walk the air.”

blocks.source: Chirón si volse in su la destra poppa,
blocks.translation: Upon his right breast Chiron wheeled about,

blocks.source: e disse a Nesso: «Torna, e sì li guida,
blocks.translation: And said to Nessus: “Turn and do thou guide them,

blocks.source: e fa cansar s’altra schiera v’intoppa».
blocks.translation: And warn aside, if other band may meet you.”

blocks.source: Or ci movemmo con la scorta fida
blocks.translation: We with our faithful escort onward moved

blocks.source: lungo la proda del bollor vermiglio,
blocks.translation: Along the brink of the vermilion boiling,

blocks.source: dove i bolliti facieno alte strida.
blocks.translation: Wherein the boiled were uttering loud laments.

blocks.source: Io vidi gente sotto infino al ciglio;
blocks.translation: People I saw within up to the eyebrows,

blocks.source: e ’l gran centauro disse: «E’ son tiranni
blocks.translation: And the great Centaur said: “Tyrants are these,

blocks.source: che dier nel sangue e ne l’aver di piglio.
blocks.translation: Who dealt in bloodshed and in pillaging.

blocks.source: Quivi si piangon li spietati danni;
blocks.translation: Here they lament their pitiless mischiefs; here

blocks.source: quivi è Alessandro, e Dïonisio fero
blocks.translation: Is Alexander, and fierce Dionysius

blocks.source: che fé Cicilia aver dolorosi anni.
blocks.translation: Who upon Sicily brought dolorous years.

blocks.source: E quella fronte c’ha ’l pel così nero,
blocks.translation: That forehead there which has the hair so black

blocks.source: è Azzolino; e quell’ altro ch’è biondo,
blocks.translation: Is Azzolin; and the other who is blond,

blocks.source: è Opizzo da Esti, il qual per vero
blocks.translation: Obizzo is of Esti, who, in truth,

blocks.source: fu spento dal figliastro sù nel mondo».
blocks.translation: Up in the world was by his stepson slain.”

blocks.source: Allor mi volsi al poeta, e quei disse:
blocks.translation: Then turned I to the Poet; and he said,

blocks.source: «Questi ti sia or primo, e io secondo».
blocks.translation: “Now he be first to thee, and second I.”

blocks.source: Poco più oltre il centauro s’affisse
blocks.translation: A little farther on the Centaur stopped

blocks.source: sovr’ una gente che ’nfino a la gola
blocks.translation: Above a folk, who far down as the throat

blocks.source: parea che di quel bulicame uscisse.
blocks.translation: Seemed from that boiling stream to issue forth.

blocks.source: Mostrocci un’ombra da l’un canto sola,
blocks.translation: A shade he showed us on one side alone,

blocks.source: dicendo: «Colui fesse in grembo a Dio
blocks.translation: Saying: “He cleft asunder in God’s bosom

blocks.source: lo cor che ’n su Tamisi ancor si cola».
blocks.translation: The heart that still upon the Thames is honoured.”

blocks.source: Poi vidi gente che di fuor del rio
blocks.translation: Then people saw I, who from out the river

blocks.source: tenean la testa e ancor tutto ’l casso;
blocks.translation: Lifted their heads and also all the chest;

blocks.source: e di costoro assai riconobb’ io.
blocks.translation: And many among these I recognised.

blocks.source: Così a più a più si facea basso
blocks.translation: Thus ever more and more grew shallower

blocks.source: quel sangue, sì che cocea pur li piedi;
blocks.translation: That blood, so that the feet alone it covered;

blocks.source: e quindi fu del fosso il nostro passo.
blocks.translation: And there across the moat our passage was.

blocks.source: «Sì come tu da questa parte vedi
blocks.translation: “Even as thou here upon this side beholdest

blocks.source: lo bulicame che sempre si scema»,
blocks.translation: The boiling stream, that aye diminishes,”

blocks.source: disse ’l centauro, «voglio che tu credi
blocks.translation: The Centaur said, “I wish thee to believe

blocks.source: che da quest’ altra a più a più giù prema
blocks.translation: That on this other more and more declines

blocks.source: lo fondo suo, infin ch’el si raggiunge
blocks.translation: Its bed, until it reunites itself

blocks.source: ove la tirannia convien che gema.
blocks.translation: Where it behoveth tyranny to groan.

blocks.source: La divina giustizia di qua punge
blocks.translation: Justice divine, upon this side, is goading

blocks.source: quell’ Attila che fu flagello in terra,
blocks.translation: That Attila, who was a scourge on earth,

blocks.source: e Pirro e Sesto; e in etterno munge
blocks.translation: And Pyrrhus, and Sextus; and for ever milks

blocks.source: le lagrime, che col bollor diserra,
blocks.translation: The tears which with the boiling it unseals

blocks.source: a Rinier da Corneto, a Rinier Pazzo,
blocks.translation: In Rinier da Corneto and Rinier Pazzo,

blocks.source: che fecero a le strade tanta guerra».
blocks.translation: Who made upon the highways so much war.”

blocks.source: Poi si rivolse e ripassossi ’l guazzo.
blocks.translation: Then back he turned, and passed again the ford.
